text: 這些實境秀的編導不但三觀有問題還很變態。 每個節目都教明星去乞討去做超出體力的體力活（所以弄死了高以翔），反正就是能怎麼虐待就怎麼虐待。 中餐廳開始的幾季還算規矩，幾個明星做飯、服務開餐廳，很辛苦但不像現在那樣將人往死裡整。  中期找來了廚師，節目就變調了，明星不燒菜了，於是就變著花樣整他們；不給錢，不給食物，讓一群明星去街上去耍賴去乞討。  既然號稱是出國宣揚文化美食就不該做這類有損形象的事。  我討厭看到那個林廚師的臭屁樣，他真不應該出現在節目裡。  不是說好明星燒菜的嗎？ 有那麼困難嗎？就算為了節目豐厚的通告費，每人去前先學幾道菜，有那麼難嗎？！ 總觀下來，他們每天就開一餐，坐位全滿不也只二、三十人而已。 一組五、六、七人整整一天的時間 做二、三十份菜，有那麼難嗎？  就讓他們做這些事，不惡整他們，不行嗎？！

text:
Heheee international fans of Esther Yu, I will sub a bit from 2:06

Chef Lin: This soup is called Di Lu(funny because its translated to dettol in English HAHA), Esther will certainly like it.

Esther Yu: Good morning Chef Lin! (Oh gawd just solely this greeting has got me in the feels skks)

Chef Lin: Morning Xin Xin! Come here

Esther Yu: How’s the preparation going? 

Chef Lin: Help me review this soup

Esther Yu: This can’t be your marketing method bah? The pot

Chef Lin: No no definitely not

Esther Yu teasing: You didnt install some live broadcast cameras here right?

Chef Lin: No no absolutely none

Chef Lin marketing (HAHHA): Chef Lin’s pot is heat resistant and has no flaws. Mu Sheng, Im coming (Holy he cosplayed as LGIEF Mu Sheng HAHA)

Chef Lin: Here, take a whiff of the soup. 

Esther Yu: Wow, it’s my favourite bamboo fungus chicken soup.

Chef Lin: I added some red mushroom in it. I planned to include it in tonight’s menu.

Esther Yu: Am I supposed to take its picture? 

Chef Lin: Oh right, to add to the menu. Yes, please do take picture.

Esther Yu: It seems very appetising.

Chef Lin: This is your favourite. Here, do a taste test. Be careful, it’s a bit hot.

text:
Esther Yu then tries to earn some support for Chef Lin to attend ZCT9 by convincing the producer at 10:12

Hello Brother Hui Ge, I will like to help Chef Lin to say a few words. I am positive that this time round he will attend ZCT with a different charisma and create interesting moments with others. 

Chef Lin: Yes and Brother Hui Ge, I have gathered Esther today with the intention to create a new dish. We hope to bring this dish to ZCT9.

Esther Yu: Expressing my love towards ZCT audience with this dish to Morocco. 

Producer: As a directing producer, I hope that every season of ZCT will be a soothing journey. (Soothing [舒心] rhymes with Esther’s chinese name, 书欣 hehe) But it’s a pity this time round for Esther. As we decided the guest list in advance.

Esther: Yes, you decided the guest list in advance.

Producer: No choice but I still hope that every year is full of abundance. (年年有鱼，the 鱼 also rhymes with Esther’s chinese character 虞 HAHA) Every year’s ZCT will have Esther Yu. This is my sincere thought. Anyways, whatever Esther Yu said, I will remember it forever.

Esther Yu: Producers always say this, will remember it forever. I wanna see the words become reality, become actions. 

Producer: I think Chef Lin since you’re today together with young Esther Yu to film this episode. You should maintain this young spirit and heart. 
(Prepare yourself for this..cause its hella confusing) So I will tell you tomorrow whether you can attend ZCT9 the day after. So that the day day after you can come promptly, just wait for our news :)

Hence, if tomorrow he agreed to Chef Lin attending, he can pack up and fly instantly. Making the transportation plan very convenient.
